title: Camera mount & FOV noise — wrist + exo
desc: Per-episode jitter of the AUTHORED camera mounts (stock config, both cameras; upstream DROID-wrist / RBY1-head recipes): wrist ±4° FOV, ±1.5/0.5/1 cm, (8,4,4)° orientation; exo ±3° FOV, ±1 cm, ±4°. Complements the randomized exocentric camera above — that path re-samples the exo pose from scratch (randcam config), and its wrist cam gets this same jitter.
